sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233204 (public search API, 5 sites), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233204 (all 5 sites NONELECTRIC, Water Hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 1 group site (up to 25 people, four RVs, six vehicles; 48 ft), 3 individual RV/tent sites (36, 37 and 58 ft, back-in) and 1 tent site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233204 ('1 group camping site, 3 individual RV/tent sites, and 1 tent site') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233204 (Max Vehicle Length 36/37/58 on the standard sites, 48 group, 15 tent; Driveway Entry Back-in), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No trash collection (pack it out). Host on site. No day-use area; the boat launch and swim beach are a mile north at Lake Alva Campground.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233204 ('Accessible vault toilets are provided, there is no drinking water available at the campground. Trash collection is not available', 'Campground hosts onsite 24 hours a day') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lakeside-campground ('Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Open May 22, 2026 - September 8, 2026.' recreation.gov: 'the Friday before Memorial Day through Labor Day, when the campground closes for the season'; access road gated and unplowed in early spring and late fall.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lakeside-campground (Seasons of Use) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233204 (facility description; notice 'Access to the campground in the early spring and late fall is closed, roads are not plowed, gate is closed.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $5 per additional vehicle after two. Group site $50.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lakeside-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night (max 10 people)', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per each additional vehicle, after 2 vehicles') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233204/rates (2026 and 2027 peak seasons: standard sites $10, group $50), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service (Seeley Lake Ranger District). All 5 sites reservable on recreation.gov; 'Reservations cannot exceed 7 nights', 32 nights a year. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233204 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 7, maxStay 32 each year; notices 'Reservations cannot exceed 7 nights', check-in/out times) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/lakeside-campground ('Make Reservations Here'), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo NF campground on Lake Alva, ~10 mi N of Seeley Lake on the west side of MT-83, in shade near the lake. Loons nest on the lake (protected nesting areas May-June); no-wake lake. --Claude
